CheckTitle: Security Group allow ingress traffic from non-RFC1918 address
Description: Security Groups found allowing ingress traffic from non-RFC1918 address (wide-open IP address with a mask between 0 and 24).
Risk: Misconfigured security groups increase the attack surface for the instance.

Recommendation.Text: Review and update the IP permissions of the Security Groups, in order to restrict ingress traffic to only the necessary ports and trusted sources based on your specific requirements.
